content.comment_body: Hello, I have [product_name] V8.3 installed on my laptop (Windows 10 Pro), but when I open the application, it closes immediately after showing the welcome popup. I've tried reinstalling Windows from scratch. The V8.0 version works, but installing V8.3 causes the same problem again. I have also tried disabling the Windows antivirus, but that didn't help. Any suggestions? Thanks.

Hello. Have you found a solution? If not: Check which version of Windows 10 you have (32bit or 64bit) and verify if [product_name] V8.3 is compatible with your system. Also, check the installation location for [product_name] V8.3 (such as: C:\Program Files\[company_name]\[product_name]_V8.3) and whether your shortcut points to the correct startup file (like: C:\Program Files\[company_name]\[product_name]_V8.3\[product_name].exe). I have both versions running on my computers without issues. I've noticed that Windows 10 Pro software installed under one user sometimes doesn't run correctly for other users. Hope this helps.

Hello, Thank you for your reply. Unfortunately, I'm still facing the same problem. My Windows 10 Pro (64-bit) is fully updated and I've confirmed I'm using the correct executable file. It's strange, because I was working with V8.3 for a while without issues, but suddenly it stopped functioning, even after reinstalling Windows. I hope someone can assist with this. Thanks.

Hello again. Based on my experience, some Windows 10 Pro updates released on 23.04.2021 affected the functioning of various programs. I made a note about this for future reference. So, it's possible that your fully updated Windows configuration is causing the problem. Testing could help confirm this. Good luck with troubleshooting.

The issue may be related to certain system setups, Windows updates, or conflicts with other [company_name] software such as [product_name].
